subject.name: Example AI Vendor — fictional
jurisdictions: Thailand; applicable requirements still need verification

decision.question: Under which conditions should a fictional team run an AI vendor pilot?
decision.materiality: Personal-data exposure and unsupported automated decisions could materially change the pilot scope.

options.label: Pilot with personal data only after prerequisites are satisfied
Restricted pilot using synthetic data and human review

facts.claim: The fictional user requires data-use conditions to be clarified before uploading customer records.
facts.sourceRef: Synthetic brief, requirement 1; not a real client document

assumptions: The pilot can operate on synthetic records while privacy terms are reviewed.
unknowns: Whether signed terms restrict training use.
Whether error rates are acceptable for the pilot's intended decision.

tasks.question: Are supplied data-use terms sufficient to consider using customer records?
tasks.decisionLink: Determines whether O1 is even eligible for human review.
tasks.mandatoryBasis: Explicit requirement in the fictional user brief; not an asserted legal obligation.
tasks.priorityRationale: Data-use uncertainty can block personal-data use before any pilot begins.

hypotheses.statement: Applicable signed terms restrict training use and define deletion obligations.
hypotheses.wouldSupport: Applicable signed agreement with specific clauses and an accountable verifier.
hypotheses.wouldWeaken: Missing signatures, broad inconsistent terms or absent deletion commitments.

hypotheses.statement: The supplied materials leave material data-use obligations unresolved.
hypotheses.wouldSupport: Only marketing assertions or unsigned draft terms are supplied.
hypotheses.wouldWeaken: Applicable signed terms and qualified review resolve the identified gaps.

evidenceTargets.description: Supplied signed agreement, DPA and retention terms
evidenceTargets.preferredSource: Executed contractual documents supplied by authorized parties
evidenceTargets.verification: Inspect applicability, signatures, clauses and contradictions; obtain qualified review where needed.

outcomes.observation: Terms and required specialist review support the proposed scope.
outcomes.action: Submit personal-data pilot conditions for human approval.

outcomes.observation: Terms are absent or material questions remain.
outcomes.action: Limit any pilot to synthetic data while resolving the terms.
Defer until an acceptable data boundary is established.

stopRules.sufficientEvidence: Relevant terms are inspected and the responsible reviewer can explain remaining obligations.
stopRules.unavailableEvidence: Return blocked and identify the missing document/owner; do not infer compliance.
stopRules.budgetExhausted: Return partial with the personal-data decision gate still open.

tasks.question: Do supplied synthetic-task evaluations support the intended level of human oversight?
tasks.decisionLink: Determines whether a restricted pilot is useful and what outputs require review.
tasks.priorityRationale: An existing synthetic evaluation can expose decision-relevant failures without live customer data.

hypotheses.statement: The evaluation supports a bounded pilot with a workable human-review process.
hypotheses.wouldSupport: Representative seeded cases, observed errors and a reviewer workflow that catches material failures.
hypotheses.wouldWeaken: Critical misses, unrepresentative examples or no measured reviewer effectiveness.

hypotheses.statement: The evidence is too weak to justify the intended use without further evaluation.
hypotheses.wouldSupport: Unrepresentative sample, missing logs or unsupported acceptance thresholds.
hypotheses.wouldWeaken: Relevant independently checked evaluation and documented acceptance criteria.

evidenceTargets.description: Synthetic evaluation protocol, logs and reviewer observations
evidenceTargets.verification: Inspect the denominator, seeded failures, review procedure and relevance to the proposed use; no model run is implied.

outcomes.observation: Evidence supports the bounded review workflow.
outcomes.action: Propose a restricted pilot with stated acceptance criteria.

outcomes.observation: Critical failures remain or the test does not represent the use case.
outcomes.action: Defer the intended use and commission a targeted evaluation.

stopRules.sufficientEvidence: The observed failure modes and review limits are sufficient to choose a next step.
stopRules.unavailableEvidence: Return inconclusive and identify the missing evaluation record.
stopRules.budgetExhausted: Return the observed evidence and uncertainty; do not invent a pass rate.

deferred.question: Would a full enterprise rollout reduce total operating cost?
deferred.whyDeferred: A rollout decision is not being made in this pilot scope.
deferred.reopenIf: A bounded pilot meets acceptance criteria and a rollout is proposed.

exclusions: Fictional example only; no real vendor, legal review, registry search or model evaluation was performed.
